title: Brazilian Portuguese - Law & Ethics Subject Matter Expert (SME)
description: Project Overview Help shape the future of AI in Brazil! We are building a next‑generation benchmark to evaluate how well AI systems handle complex, real‑world questions in Brazilian Portuguese. This project will help improve how AI delivers accurate, reliable, and context‑aware responses for the Brazilian market. We are seeking Brazilian Portuguese Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) in Law & Ethics to create high‑quality, expert‑level question‑and‑answer content. This role goes beyond basic data labeling and requires deep domain knowledge, critical thinking, and strong writing skills to test advanced reasoning and contextual understanding in Brazilian Portuguese. Suitable backgrounds include practicing lawyers or legal counsels with senior‑level experience; judges or former judicial clerks; legal scholars or researchers; ethics professionals or compliance officers; applied ethics specialists (including bioethics, legal ethics, or technology ethics); public policy or regulatory experts; legal advisors within government institutions or international organizations; academics or practitioners specializing in constitutional, administrative, or human‑rights law; and recognized authors or public intellectuals working in law, ethics, or public policy. Please submit your resume/CV in English.
min_qualifications: Native or fluent proficiency in Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR) 5–10+ years of professional experience in a relevant field Demonstrated expertise through academic background and/or industry experience Strong analytical skills and the ability to explain complex concepts in a clear, structured manner Excellent written communication skills and attention to detail Ability to work independently and deliver high-quality output in a guideline-driven environment Nice to Have Experience with content creation, research, education, or knowledge evaluation Familiarity with AI training, data annotation, or evaluation projects Background in interdisciplinary work (e.g. political theory, history, moral philosophy, public policy, business or technology ethics) #LI-CAN17
